question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Go bananas
solution:
The correct answer is "**To become excited or angry**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Go bananas' is an idiom that means to become extremely excited or angry.**
 
• अत्यधिक उत्तेजित या क्रोधित होना
 
• The phrase is often used to describe someone's emotional state when they are overreacting or losing control.
 
• The idiom is believed to have originated from the behavior of monkeys, who are known to become very animated and energetic when they eat bananas.
 
 
• Example: She'll go bananas when you tell her the news. 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that option 4 correctly explains the given idiom.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
